高精度座標付き点群スキャン 誰でも簡単3D点群取得・出来形管理要領に準拠

  • フォトグラメトリで法枠のエッジも綺麗に取得
  • 距離・勾配を計測

AR座標誘導チラシ

マーカーなしズレないAR 前処理なし。cm精度で現場にAR投影。出来形管理もこれ1つ

  • 2D平面図を現場でAR投影
  • クラウドで座標や2D・3D図面を管理
  • 設計3D図面と現況を比較　出来形ヒートマップで施工管理
  • 施工後イメージを共有
  • 施工前後を可視化、スキャンした座標付き3DモデルをそのままAR

座標誘導 杭打ち座標や境界座標へ簡単に誘導 線形データを使った線形誘導機能も搭載 設計データの各要素へ誘導します

  • 杭位置を簡単確認

  • Verbatim text transcribed from photographs and translated into English. Sources: the LRTK Phone flyer and the AR coordinate-guidance flyer, 2 photographs in total. LRTK Phone Flyer

LRTK Phone Your smartphone transforms into a high-precision, all-purpose surveying instrument

NETIS Registration No. TH-260013-A

With your smartphone and LRTK Phone, position information at cm-level accuracy!

With CLAS support, high-precision positioning is possible even outdoors!

Product information (QR code)

(Product photo: a hand holding a smartphone fitted with the LRTK Phone; "LOCK OPEN" and "LRTK" logos on the case)

Point-cloud scanning with high-precision coordinates Easy 3D point-cloud acquisition for anyone — compliant with as-built management guidelines

  • Photogrammetry captures even slope-frame edges cleanly
  • Measure distances and gradients
  • Gaussian splatting
  • Easy earthwork volume calculation

AR Coordinate-Guidance Flyer

Markerless, drift-free AR No preprocessing. AR projection on site at cm-level accuracy. As-built management with this one tool

  • Project 2D drawings onto the site in AR
  • Manage coordinates and 2D/3D drawings in the cloud
  • Compare design 3D drawings with actual conditions; construction management with as-built heat maps
  • Share post-construction images
  • Visualize before/after construction; use scanned 3D models with coordinates directly in AR

Coordinate guidance Easily guides you to stakeout coordinates and boundary coordinates Includes a linear guidance function using alignment data Guides you to each element of the design data

  • Easily check stake positions
